hints.title: Locking State Tracking
hints.text: Store the lock status of each node as locked_by[num] = user, where 0 denotes an unlocked state.

hints.title: Upgrade Conditions Verification
hints.text: To upgrade node num: verify that num is unlocked, no ancestor of num is locked (traverse parent pointers to root), and at least one descendant is locked (search child subtree).

hints.title: Batch Unlocking Descendants
hints.text: If all conditions hold, lock node num for user and traverse its entire subtree to unlock all descendants.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) for lock and unlock; O(H + N) for upgrade
complexity.space: O(N) for tree adjacency and state arrays
variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Parent pointer upward walk and subtree traversal for upgrade.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to check all ancestors or missing locked descendants violates concurrency constraints.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Explicit adjacency list speeds up descendant traversal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement all three operations adhering strictly to tree relationship conditions.
